comparison.position: 从旧执行锚点按训练分布变化transport中心，结合old-training下log-ratio方差与outward-only软衰减；importance和gate在反传时冻结。CPU执行full-vocab和附B head-tail公式，不运行执行引擎或RL。
comparison.tradeoff: RSC在固定behavior下用独立auxiliary动作估计center并加reverse-KL；EPRO使center随transport变化，再按分布移动衰减outward更新。固定behavior校正、预测执行策略和实际执行误差是不同对象，不能把两者都简化成reward减均值。没有共同LLM训练测量，不比较能力。

analysis.title: 分布预测不是分布观测，score中心也不是reward中心
analysis.body: EPRO Eq.2通过mu0*pi_current/pi0归一化构造当前执行策略预测；当learner不动时恢复mu0。RSC固定behavior中心并用reverse-KL限制漂移，EPRO中心随transport演进，再由Policy Shift衰减outward贡献。预测误差上界的理论假设不由一个低Policy Shift自动保证；附B单tail bucket还会隐藏尾部内部变化。CPU有限差分必须固定importance与SSC系数，否则检验的是另一条梯度。full/head-tail梯度差是公开的近似边界，不是要求消掉的失败。

question.question: EPRO和RSC都做score centering，为何仍要区分固定behavior与transport分布？
question.answer: learner多次更新后，旧执行behavior不变，而transport分布借训练变化移动。两种中心对同一score的期望可不同；再加RSC的reverse-KL与EPRO的SSC并非等价约束。
question.example: 教学例：训练与执行旧锚点有偏差时，零learner变化必须恢复旧执行锚点；后续改变训练概率时移动中心，而不是只把reward减去组均值。

update.summary: 实际重读RSC当前README并对照EPRO固定v1 Eq.2/8/10–12与附B，新增固定behavior中心和transport预测中心的区别，保留STE/预测误差假设、冻结乘数和tail粗粒化边界。两者本地组件不能构成同预算能力比较；EPRO完整四模型RL高成本不复现，审查DONE。

comparison.position: Transport the old execution anchor with training-policy movement, then combine old-training log-ratio variance with outward-only soft attenuation. Importance and gate are frozen for differentiation. CPU code implements full-vocabulary and AppendixB head-tail equations, not an execution engine or RL trainer.
comparison.tradeoff: RSC estimates its center under fixed behavior using independent auxiliary actions and adds reverse KL. EPRO moves the center through transport and attenuates outward updates using distribution movement. Fixed-behavior correction, predicted execution and measured execution error are different objects, not reward-mean subtraction. No common LLM training measurement ranks their capabilities.

analysis.title: A predicted distribution is not an observed distribution; score centering is not reward centering
analysis.body: EPRO Eq.2 normalizes mu0*pi_current/pi0 to predict current execution and recovers mu0 when the learner is unchanged. RSC keeps behavior fixed and limits drift with reverse KL; EPRO moves its center with transport and attenuates outward contributions using Policy Shift. Low shift alone does not establish the prediction-error bound assumed by theory. AppendixB's one tail bucket can hide internal tail movement. Finite differences must freeze importance and SSC coefficients, or they test a different gradient. Full/head-tail differences are a disclosed approximation boundary, not a failure to erase.

question.question: Why distinguish fixed behavior from transported distributions if both EPRO and RSC center scores?
question.answer: After learner updates, old execution behavior remains fixed while transport moves with training-policy changes. Their expectations of the same score can differ. RSC reverse KL and EPRO SSC are also inequivalent controls.
question.example: Teaching example: with distinct engine anchors, zero learner movement must recover the old execution anchor. Later training-policy changes move the center rather than merely subtracting group-mean reward.

english.update: Re-read the current RSC README against fixed-v1 EPRO Eqs.2/8/10–12 and AppendixB. Added fixed-behavior versus transported-prediction centering while preserving STE/prediction-error assumptions, frozen multipliers and coarse tail limits. Local components do not constitute a matched-budget capability comparison; full four-model EPRO RL is high-cost and not reproduced, review DONE.

comparison.position: 五维ordinal相关性奖励、同query文档PNR与terminal六digit margin，再以训练期生成监督辅助五分类head；本地仅CPU reward/目标及logit梯度，不构造CoT或运行网络。
comparison.tradeoff: Yuanbao Rubric以query特定标准统一检索、排序与集合选择；LARF把训练信号落到单文档五维等级和terminal决策。PNR有序pair不等于跨文档rubric覆盖，dual-head联合目标也不是蒸馏组内最佳轨迹；线上链路和指标不能相加。

analysis.title: 同在元宝搜索，监督对象仍要区分文档等级与集合效用
analysis.body: LARF Eq.3–5排除gold tie，把predicted tie计半分，再按组规模缩放有序一致性；Yuanbao Rubric允许多个文档共同覆盖正标准、任一文档触发负标准。LARF Eq.8–10对所有非gold六digit取最强竞争者，不只相邻等级；其Eq.12在训练保留生成head，服务时才删除。Gold-conditioned CoT仅是训练target构造，不能转化为评测Agent可见gold。两篇生产A/B的真实对照均有价值，但HSR/LSR与GSB不是同一指标，LARF8B离线50.98也不属于1.7B部署学生。

question.question: PNR奖励很高是否说明证据集合已满足query rubric？
question.answer: 不说明。PNR只看同query文档的预测等级是否复现gold顺序；rubric集合效用关心多文档覆盖与负标准触发。正确顺序仍可能缺关键事实或包含触发扣分的文档。
question.example: 教学例：两个文档顺序都排对但都遗漏日期证据，PNR可高而时效rubric未覆盖；补一篇日期文档可能提高集合覆盖而不改变原pair顺序。

update.summary: 实际重读Yuanbao Rubric当前README与LARF固定v1全文，补充单文档ordinal/PNR/terminal监督和多文档rubric集合效用的界线，并分开训练期gold构造、生成head训练、仅分类服务及8B/1.7B指标。LARF仅CPU公式组件；64H20私有完整流程成本过高不复现，审查DONE。

comparison.position: Five-dimensional ordinal rewards, within-query document PNR and terminal six-digit margin, followed by generation-supervised training of five classification heads. Local code only implements CPU rewards/objectives and logit gradients, without CoT construction or a network.
comparison.tradeoff: Yuanbao Rubric unifies retrieval, ranking and set selection with query-specific criteria. LARF targets document grades and terminal decisions. Ordered PNR pairs are not cross-document rubric coverage, and dual-head training is not best-trajectory distillation; online pipelines and metrics are not additive.

analysis.title: Shared Yuanbao Search context does not make document grades and set utility identical
analysis.body: LARF Eqs.3–5 exclude gold ties, give half credit to predicted ties and scale ordered concordance by group size. Yuanbao Rubric allows joint positive coverage and negative triggers from any document. LARF Eqs.8–10 choose the strongest among all non-gold digit classes, not only adjacent grades; Eq.12 retains generation in training and deletes it only in serving. Gold-conditioned CoT is training-target construction, not gold visibility for an evaluated agent. Both real production baselines matter, but HSR/LSR differ from GSB, and LARF8B offline50.98 is not the deployed1.7B student's result.

question.question: Does high PNR imply that an evidence set satisfies the query rubric?
question.answer: No. PNR checks whether predicted document grades reproduce gold order within a query. Rubric set utility concerns joint coverage and negative triggers. Correct order can still miss key facts or include a penalized document.
question.example: Teaching example: two correctly ordered documents both omit date evidence; PNR can be high with an uncovered timeliness criterion. Adding a dated source can improve coverage without changing their pair order.

english.update: Re-read the current Yuanbao Rubric README and full fixed-v1 LARF. Added the boundary between document ordinal/PNR/terminal supervision and multi-document rubric utility, separating training-side gold construction, generation-head training, classification-only serving and8B/1.7B evidence. LARF is CPU formula components only; the private64-H20 pipeline is too expensive and not reproduced, review DONE.
